description: The bombing's aftermath reshuffles nearly every relationship. Alison recovers, Brooke's marriage to Billy implodes, Amanda's past catches up with her, Kimberly's fractured identity worsens, and Peter, Bobby, Sydney, Jane and Richard are drawn into schemes that make ordinary apartment drama seem almost quaint.

s04e01.description: Kimberly detonates the Melrose bombs, leaving the building devastated, MacKenzie dead and Alison temporarily blinded as Billy pulls her to safety.

s04e02.description: Residents scatter into temporary housing while repairs begin, and Jake spirals into drinking after the violent death of his brother.

s04e03.description: Alison's sight returns but she hides the recovery from Brooke, while Brooke uncovers evidence of Amanda's mysterious past under another name.

s04e04.description: Brooke blackmails Amanda for a promotion, Billy learns Alison can see again, and Michael uses Sydney to destabilize Kimberly.

s04e05.description: Kimberly admits that visions of a man named Henry are driving her toward violence, alarming Michael and her visiting mother.

s04e06.description: Jane resumes her engagement to Richard despite admitting she does not love him, leaving Jo increasingly worried about the decision.

s04e07.description: Brooke lands Jack's cable company for the advertising agency, while Michael hires an actor to impersonate Kimberly's imaginary Henry.

s04e08.description: Michael and Kimberly wage their private war on the radio, Peter neglects Kimberly for Amanda, and Alison prepares to move in with Hayley.

s04e09.description: A frightened Amanda drinks heavily at Halloween and sleeps with Peter, while Michael secretly changes Matt's medical-board result.

s04e10.description: Jack dies after his confrontation with Amanda, and Sydney exploits the aftermath by blackmailing Amanda and Peter for a share of the estate.

s04e11.description: Alison and Hayley honeymoon in Cancun while Jack's family sends Bobby to Los Angeles with ominous instructions concerning Amanda.

s04e12.description: Kimberly's latest romantic encounter places her in danger when the man involved proves to be the stalker threatening her radio show.

s04e13.description: Kimberly abandons radio to pursue psychiatry, while Amanda suspects Bobby has come to kill her and hears a very different explanation.

s04e14.description: Brooke blames Alison for Hayley's death and pushes police scrutiny, while Jake turns to a loan shark to keep Shooters afloat.

s04e15.description: Brooke conceals that she is not pregnant, and Sydney drugs recovering Jane when Michael's attention becomes intolerable.

s04e16.description: Jane is left partially paralyzed by a stroke, while Brooke disguises her false pregnancy by claiming a miscarriage to Billy.

s04e17.description: Michael leaves after Sydney catches him exploiting Jane's vulnerability, while Jake refuses a violent collection job for his loan shark.

s04e18.description: Brooke lashes out when Alison offers sympathy, while Sydney maneuvers Jane out of the beach house to bring Michael home.

s04e19.description: Bobby's refusal to kill Amanda enrages his family, and Michael extracts the truth from Kimberly about Sydney drugging Jane.

s04e20-21.description: Peter pays Sydney to lure Bobby away from Amanda, but Sydney instead warns Bobby that Peter is deliberately targeting the relationship. Vic is mistakenly released from prison, forcing Michael to confront the immediate danger now facing Kimberly.

s04e22.description: Billy is haunted by Brooke after her death, while Michael works obsessively to persuade Kimberly to resume their marriage.

s04e23.description: Old divorce papers wound Kimberly just as Michael reconciles with her, while Sydney turns a harassment complaint into unexpected workplace power.

s04e24.description: Billy uses seduction and stolen strategy to win Amanda a prestigious airline account, revealing how ruthless his ambition has become.

s04e25.description: Alison recoils from Billy's new win-at-any-cost personality, while a distressed Matt makes a drunken choice with his friend Dave.

s04e26.description: Sydney persuades Amanda to drop charges against Bobby, while Peter cuts a deal designed to escape Alycia's financial hold over him.

s04e27.description: Billy steals an advertising keynote from Alison through underhanded tactics, while Richard hires Claire to undermine Jake and Jane.

s04e28.description: Peter enters Amanda's apartment uninvited, while Sydney's fears about Bobby's family and hidden money take an increasingly paranoid turn.

s04e29.description: Teri threatens Michael with exposure unless Peter takes the blame, while Sydney accidentally finances a decidedly disreputable film venture.

s04e30.description: Amanda neutralizes Teri with a cosmetics deal, while Sydney learns Peter and Alycia may have conspired to destroy Bobby.

s04e31.description: Kimberly drugs Peter and has him committed to the hospital she controls, while Billy asks Jake to help him recover Alison.

s04e32.description: Michael and Amanda search for Peter and Kimberly, while Jane coerces Sydney into helping with her lethal plan for Richard.

s04e33-34.description: Michael and Amanda interrupt Peter's planned lobotomy, but Kimberly's Betsy persona captures them and Peter is arrested for Bobby's death. Peter remains jailed without Kimberly's usable alibi, prompting Amanda to marry him in jail as multiple conspiracies collapse around them.
